verdict.rationale: Dynadot's docs claim instant availability checks, including bulk search results 'in seconds', and an AI search that suggests alternate names and TLDs across 600+ extensions, which covers the speed and suggestion parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence addresses the 'honest' part: no policy or guarantee against front-running or squatting on searched names. missing for 10: documented no-front-running/search-privacy commitment, independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed and suggestion quality.

support.subject: As a founder, domain search is fast and honest — instant availability, alternate TLD suggestions, and no lookup-then-squat games on names I searched

citations.quote: Get brandable domain ideas and check availability instantly across top TLDs.
